# Suka Sushi

> > Suka Sushi is a viral NYC takeout sushi restaurant with locations in NoMad and Brooklyn, known for innovative Japanese cuisine and specialty rolls.

Suka Sushi offers quick-service, to-go sushi with unique specialty rolls that have gained significant media attention across New York City. The restaurant focuses on high-quality takeout packaging and accessible Japanese cuisine.
